name: Matching Pairs (Association)
summary: Grid of 6-12 items; connect related pairs. Matched pairs disappear. Often timed.

aiGenerability.notes: Any topic with paired facts generates matching sets trivially. AI can create countries-capitals, inventors-inventions, definitions-terms, flags-countries, historical figures-events, etc. Shuffling and pairing is automatic.

pairs.description: Array of item pairs to match (3-6 pairs typical, up to 12 for advanced).

right.description: Text of right-column item. This item should match/relate to the left item.

shuffled.description: Whether the right column should be randomly shuffled before display.

explanation.description: Optional explanation of the topic or relationships after all pairs are matched.

ux.animation: tap-highlight, pair-snap-to-matching-zone with fade-out for correct pairs
ux.mobileNotes: Two columns on mobile: left column (fixed) and right column (scrollable or grid). Tap left item, then tap right item. Matched pairs disappear with fade animation. On small screens, may use sequential tap (item A → item B → confirm) to avoid occlusion.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Maximum 3 pairs (6 items total). Large text (16pt+), simple associations (animal-habitat, color-word). Visual icons or small images alongside text. No time pressure. Feedback celebratory and encouraging.
ageAdaptations.11-13: 4-5 pairs (8-10 items). Standard text size. Associations are conceptual (country-capital, inventor-invention, definition-term). Optional timer (60-90s). Immediate per-pair feedback.
ageAdaptations.14-16: 6+ pairs (12+ items). Complex associations (historical figure-event, chemical element-property, literary work-author). Timed variant (90-120s countdown). Leaderboard-based scoring. Can include images on both sides of matching grid.
